title: Baba Teri Zahra (s.a) Nu
body:
Baba Teri Zahra(sa) Nu
Bulnay Nai Zulam Darbaar Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Jay Haq Naiy See Daina
Tazeem Hee Karr Lehnday
Teri Sanad Nu Nah Paar Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Samanay Mimbar Day Khar Kay
Sun Di Raiya May
Teray Sungti Jayray See
Hizian Day Tanay
Hus Hus Kay Raay Maarday
<<DIVIDER>>
Chum Kay lai Akiyan Day Nal
Meh Sanad Day Tukray
Teri Dee Day Jigar Tay
Zarban Vang Chal Day Raay
Khanjar Nay Ghuftaar Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Ral Kay Teray Kaatil Saray
Aag Lawan Aagay
Darwazay Day Haitaan
May Raiyaan Tarapdee
O Ghar Nu Rahay Saarday
<<DIVIDER>>
Tuk Kay Rastiyan Day Vich oh
Digg Dhi Raiy Keevain
Meri Sain Numani Nay
Kaiy Vaar Saharay
Leh Honay Nai Divar Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Hath Tay Kunfus Nay Baba
Mariyan Nay Chariyan
Menu Zakhmi Ay Keeta
Uton Rown Naio Dainday
Haq koo lay nay Haq daar day
<<DIVIDER>>
Aan Kay Mahdi Nay Badlay
Lehnay Nay Zahra Day
Harr Mujrim Noo Samar
Qabra Vicho Kad Kay
Vaar Karnay Nay Talwar Day
